ROW.COLUMN: (ML/CU) Anomalies in ATM, Bank Card: Foreign Transactions

Bank/Debit Cards can be easly used at ATMs to transfer assets to other individules or locations due to the anonymity they afford the users. Deposits can be made into accounts in any number of ways and then be removed as currency from almost any location. A sudden increase in the number or amount of ATM deposits and withdrawals may indicate an attempt to launder funds; an increase in ATM withdrawals, or change in the location of ATMs used may also indicate account takeover. Sudden increases in the activity at a certain location may indicate fraudsters` use of skimmed or compromised Bank/Debit cards. This scenario monitors foreign ATM withdrawal activity that could be indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing.

CASE WHEN (@Foreign_Country_Mode = 'A') THEN CASE WHEN (coalesce(d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD, 'NULL') not in (select ADDR_CNTRY_CD from @MINER@.ACCT_ADDR where acct_intrl_id = a.acct_intrl_id)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
WHEN (@Foreign_Country_Mode = 'B') THEN CASE WHEN (coalesce(d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD, 'NULL') not in (select ADDR_CNTRY_CD from @MINER@.ACCT_ADDR where acct_intrl_id = a.acct_intrl_id) AND coalesce(d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD, 'NULL') <> coalesce(a.INSTN_CNTRY_CD,'-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
WHEN (@Foreign_Country_Mode = 'D') THEN CASE WHEN (coalesce(d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD, 'NULL') <> coalesce(a.INSTN_CNTRY_CD,'-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END d_TRXN_CT_FRGN,
CASE WHEN (@Foreign_Country_Mode = 'A') THEN CASE WHEN (coalesce(d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD, 'NULL') not in (select ADDR_CNTRY_CD from @MINER@.ACCT_ADDR where acct_intrl_id = a.acct_intrl_id)) THEN ct1.TRXN_LOC_ID else null END

)

SELECT g.CUST_INTRL_ID , g.CUST_SEQ_ID , g.Effctv_Risk_Lvl , g.Actvty_Risk_Lvl , g.Tot_Trans_Amt , g.Tot_Trans_Ct , g.Loc_Ct , g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn , g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn , g.FUNC_CRNCY_CD , case when g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn = 0 then 0 else g.Hr_Trans_Amt/g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn*100 end as Hr_Prctg , case when g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn = 0 then 0 else g.Lrf_Trans_Amt/g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn*100 end as Lrf_Prctg , g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 as Trxn_Am_Frgn_Prctg , g.Overall_Risk
FROM ( SELECT trxn.CUST_INTRL_ID, max(trxn.CUST_SEQ_ID) as CUST_SEQ_ID,
sum(trxn.Trxn_Am) as Tot_Trans_Amt,
max(trxn.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB) as Effctv_Risk_Lvl, sum(trxn.d_TRXN_BASE_AM_FRGN) as Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn, sum(trxn.d_TRXN_CT_FRGN) as Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn, max(trxn.FUNC_CRNCY_CD) as FUNC_CRNCY_CD, count(distinct trxn.fo_trxn_seq_id) as Tot_Trans_Ct,
count(distinct trxn.Loc) as Loc_Ct,
sum(case when ((trxn.Trxn_Am - TRUNC(trxn.Trxn_Am,-@Lrf_Digits)) = 0) then trxn.Trxn_Am when ((trxn.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(trxn.TRXN_ACTVY_AM,-@Lrf_Digits)) = 0) THEN trxn.Trxn_Am else 0 end) as Lrf_Trans_Amt, sum(case when trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then trxn.Trxn_Am else 0 end) as Hr_Trans_Amt, max(trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, case when max(trxn.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB)>= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'HR' when max(trxn.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB)< @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'RR' else 'MR' end Overall_Risk
FROM sel_trxn trxn GROUP BY trxn.CUST_INTRL_ID HAVING -- Frequency_Period Period --PR33796 max(case when (trxn.d_TRXN_CT_FRGN = 1) then trxn.DATA_DUMP_DT else f_char_to_date('01011901','MMDDYYYY') end ) <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and max(case when (trxn.d_TRXN_CT_FRGN = 1) then trxn.DATA_DUMP_DT else f_char_to_date('01011901','MMDDYYYY') end ) > (select add_days(b.CLNDR_DT, - @Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) -- Exclude Customer Containing only one account and count(distinct(trxn.acct_intrl_id)) >= @Min_Acct_Ct )g WHERE --BUG 29390142 g.Tot_Trans_Amt <> 0 and ( ( g.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn >= @HR_Min_Number_of_Foreign_WD and g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 >= @HR_Pct_Foreign_WD_Amt and g.Loc_Ct >= @HR_Min_Number_of_Dist_Locations ) or ( g.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn >= @MR_Min_Number_of_Foreign_WD and g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 >= @MR_Pct_Foreign_WD_Amt and g.Loc_Ct >= @MR_Min_Number_of_Dist_Locations ) or ( g.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn >= @RR_Min_Number_of_Foreign_WD and g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 >= @RR_Pct_Foreign_WD_Amt and g.Loc_Ct >= @RR_Min_Number_of_Dist_Locations ) )

WHEN (@Foreign_Country_Mode = 'B') THEN CASE WHEN (coalesce(d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD, 'NULL') not in (select ADDR_CNTRY_CD from @MINER@.ACCT_ADDR where acct_intrl_id = a.acct_intrl_id) AND coalesce(d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD, 'NULL') <> coalesce(a.INSTN_CNTRY_CD,'-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
